portInfo.description: Norwegian port city in the Arctic region, known for midnight sun, northern lights, and beautiful coastal scenery.

facts.established: Founded 1904, but area inhabited since Viking Age
facts.significance: Important port in northern Norway with Arctic attractions

size.annualVisitors: Popular on Norwegian coastal and Arctic cruise itineraries

climate.description: Subarctic climate with cool summers and cold, snowy winters

politics.visaRequirements: Schengen Area rules apply, visa-free for many nationalities
politics.entryRequirements: Valid passport required, EU citizens need ID card

gettingThere.walkingTime: 10-20 minutes to downtown—confirm on your sailing programme before you rely on a fixed walk time.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Harbourfront and church district near the quay
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Confirm “Larsneset Nord” on the day’s programme — older industrial berths are not assumed here.
